name: World Bank DataBank
notes: DataBank is live and offers free public access to World Bank databases (databases labeled Public, Public Login option). The World Bank summary terms of use for data state: 'You may copy, distribute, adapt, display or include the data in other products for commercial or noncommercial purposes at no cost under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License', confirming the recorded CC-BY-4.0 licence, open access and full-text-open reuse. Evidence: https://databank.worldbank.org and https://data.worldbank.org/summary-terms-of-use (read 2026-11-12)
